name: 200mg | Pomegranate 1:1 CBD + Hybrid Enhanced Gummies
description:
*HIGH DOSE* We’ve taken the best of both worlds with our Pomegranate 1:1 THC:CBD gummies. They are a great compliment to any adventure by providing a balanced and enjoyable high for both mind and body using a Hybrid terpene blend. If you are new or sensitive to edibles, the Pomegranate gummies are an excellent place to start. Have some before getting into your yoga routine, or climbing to the highest peak. It’s a little like getting a high five from your imaginary friend. Enjoy!

200mg THC:200mg CBD per package, 10mg THC:10mg CBD per 1/2 gummy serving. 10 gummies per package.
